text:
claire: opened a small PR to clarify the variant matrix and embed/context limits on the catalog page. fixes include: broken vanguard-bench permalink, split limits column into tokens vs context, and a short migration checklist for deprecated variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5380 :wave:

ryan: quick skim  looks good. two asks: 1) add a one-line note about quantized fallback behavior on low-memory nodes, 2) confirm perf permalink resolves for vanguard.

mei: Regarding the limits column, i recommend stacked cells: "tokens (max_tokens)" then "context (max_sequence)" so readers don't mix the units. i'll add a tiny footnote explaining units and device used for benches.

claire: added stacked cells and a footnote that lists rig details (a100-40gb, seq=1536, dyn-batching=off). also added a compatibility note: "quantized variants may expose reduced max_sequence; verify variant limits before pinning."

perf-bot: artifact check: /bench/vanguard/2026-03-28/vanguard_throughput.csv -> NOT FOUND. please re-upload or provide new permalink.

claire: pinged perf team, they re-uploaded to /bench/vanguard/2026-03-29/vanguard_throughput_v2.csv and i updated the PR permalink.

ryan: nice. also swap the SDK snippet that used the old `list_models()` call to `catalog.list_variants()` and show the limits keys. tiny example below: 
```python
from redwood import CatalogClient
cat = CatalogClient()
for v in cat.list_variants("vanguard"):
    print(v["name"], v["limits"])
```

mei: added that snippet. also included a short deterministic diff example for migration: `redwood eval --model vanguard-legacy --model vanguard-v2 --prompt-file smoke.txt --temperature 0.0 --top_k 1 --output diffs.json` and a canary recommendation (5% for 24h).

docs-bot: lint warning: table cell width exceeds 120 chars at /catalog/variants.md line 276. suggest moving bench rig details to footnote.

claire: moved rig detail into the footnote and shortened the inline bench notes. pushed. CI is running.

ryan: approved pending CI. small nit on wording which i left as a review comment.

perf-bot: artifact check: /bench/vanguard/2026-03-29/vanguard_throughput_v2.csv -> OK.

claire: thanks all  merging after green CI. follow-up: i'll open a small PR to sweep old sdk hrefs (redirects) and add a docs CI task that validates benchmark permalinks to avoid future 404s.

mei: sounds good. nice cleanup.
